title: Vista Mini Wireless Charger
description:
True convenience as found its way to the new vista mini with the vista mini wireless charger.
To charge your vista mini with this wireless charger all you need to do is place the vista mini down on the wireless charger. Presto.. charging will begin.
Included
Vista Mini Wireless Charger
USB Cable
